title: CRAX: Fast Safe Reinforcement Learning Benchmarking
abstract: arXiv:2606.20376v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Safety is a core concern for deploying reinforcement learning (RL) agents in real-world domains such as robotics and autonomous driving. While benchmarks have been central to progress in RL, existing 3D physics-based safety benchmarks remain computationally slow, limiting large-scale experimentation and rapid prototyping. To address this gap, we propose CRAX (Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX). Built on top of the MuJoCo XLA (MJX) physics engine, CRAX leverages vectorized operations and hardware acceleration, yielding up to 200x faster training over comparable CPU-based safety benchmarks. The benchmark features eight tasks spanning three difficulty levels and multiple agent morphologies. Evaluating seven popular safe RL methods, we find that none dominates across tasks, and that learning safe policies from pixels remains largely unsolved.

translated_title: CRAX：快速安全强化学习基准测试
translated_abstract: 安全性是在机器人和自动驾驶等现实领域部署强化学习（RL）智能体的核心关注点。虽然基准测试一直是强化学习进展的关键，但现有的基于3D物理的安全基准测试在计算上仍然缓慢，限制了大规模实验和快速原型设计。为了解决这一差距，我们提出了CRAX（Constrained RL Accelerated with JAX，使用JAX加速的约束强化学习）。CRAX构建在MuJoCo XLA（MJX）物理引擎之上，利用向量化操作和硬件加速，与同类基于CPU的安全基准相比，训练速度最高可提升200倍。该基准测试包含八个任务，涵盖三个难度级别和多种智能体形态。通过评估七种流行的安全强化学习方法，我们发现没有任何一种方法能够在所有任务上占据优势，并且从像素中学习安全策略的问题在很大程度上仍未解决。
tldr: CRAX是一个基于MJX物理引擎和JAX硬件加速的安全强化学习基准测试，训练速度比基于CPU的基准最高快200倍，其评估结果显示现有安全强化学习方法均无全面优势，且从像素学习安全策略的问题仍未解决。
en_tdlr: CRAX is a safe RL benchmark built on the MJX physics engine with JAX acceleration that achieves up to 200x faster training than CPU-based benchmarks, and its evaluation of seven safe RL methods reveals that none dominates across tasks and learning safe policies from pixels remains largely unsolved.
